title: Replay overrides
description: `<replay id>/overrides.json`: what people changed about a stored replay through `PATCH /api/replays/<id>/meta`, also what `GET /api/replays/<id>/meta` answers. The bundle stays as recorded; these apply on top of it wherever the replay is listed or opened. A field that is absent keeps the recorded value. Source of truth: src/shared/schemas/replay-meta.ts.

tags.description: Replaces the recorded tags; an empty list drops them.

purpose.description: One of the deployment's purposes, or null for none (an inferred purpose may then apply).

by.description: The identity that made the last change.
